headings.usage: Use for all main dashboard headings, section titles, and KPI values. Never use Inter for headings.

body.usage: Use for all body text, tables, forms, and secondary text.

primary.note: Deep emerald used in place of teal to maintain professional real-estate aesthetic while adhering to system color restrictions.

visual_enhancers.cards: bg-white border border-stone-200 rounded-lg shadow-sm hover:shadow-md transition-shadow duration-200
visual_enhancers.borders: Use 1px subtle borders (border-stone-200) to separate grid items and table rows.
visual_enhancers.buttons: Rounded-md (not fully pill, but crisp). Primary buttons use emerald-900. Interaction animations required (scale down slightly on active).

component_strategy.tables: Dense, cardless style with subtle borders. Must include inline filters, global search, and export actions at the top.
component_strategy.charts: Recharts. Use simple line charts for revenue trends, bar charts for inventory status, and simple donut charts for expenses. Colors should align with the semantic palette.
component_strategy.modals: Use Shadcn Dialog. Must have a semi-transparent dark overlay (bg-black/40 backdrop-blur-sm). Used for 'Raise Expense' with file upload zone.
component_strategy.forms: Shadcn components. Use Input, Select, Checkbox. Dense spacing (gap-4).
component_strategy.sidebar: Dark theme sidebar (bg-stone-900) with white text, emerald-900 highlights for active state. Contains role-aware navigation.
component_strategy.toasts: Use Sonner for toast notifications (success/error states for form submissions).

dashboard_grid.base: grid grid-cols-1 md:grid-cols-3 lg:grid-cols-4 gap-4 md:gap-6

grids_and_layouts.page_layout: Flex container with fixed Sidebar on left (w-64) and main scrollable content area on right.
grids_and_layouts.spacing: Generous internal padding for main containers (p-6 or p-8). Tight spacing for data-heavy sections (gap-4).

motion.hover_states: All interactive elements must have explicit hover states (e.g., hover:bg-stone-100 hover:text-stone-900).
motion.page_transitions: Subtle fade-in for page loads using framer-motion.
motion.lists: Staggered entrance animations for table rows and grid cards.

accessibility.contrast: Ensure all text meets WCAG AA standards. No light gray text on white backgrounds.
accessibility.testing: All interactive elements MUST include a `data-testid` attribute (e.g., `data-testid="login-button"`).
accessibility.focus: Clear focus rings (focus:ring-2 focus:ring-emerald-500 focus:outline-none) on all inputs and buttons.

instructions_to_main_agent: Build the layout using a Sidebar on the left and a Header on top of the main content.
Implement role-based mock routing (Admin, Accounts, Management, Site Manager).
Use Recharts for the main dashboard analytics (Units Sold/Available, Revenue vs Target).
Build standard Shadcn Tables for Project Inventory, Expenses, and Stock Book.
Implement the 2-stage approval workflow UI using distinct status pills (Pending, Stage 1 Approved, Final Approved).
Do not use `.App { text-align: center; }` or center-align generic text.
Ensure all interactive elements have `data-testid` attributes.
UNIVERSAL_GUIDELINES_FOR_MAIN_AGENT: You tend to converge toward generic, 'on distribution' outputs. In frontend design, this creates what users call the 'AI slop' aesthetic. Avoid this: make creative, distinctive frontends that surprise and delight.
Dark colors look good when used independently without gradients. DO NOT use dark colors as gradients.
Don't make generic centered layouts, simplistic gradients, and uniform styling.
Create depth through layered design elements with z-index hierarchy.
Use glass-morphism effects with backdrop filters (12-24px blur).
You MUST NOT apply universal transition. Eg: `transition: all`. This results in breaking transforms. Always add transitions for specific interactive elements like button, input excluding transforms.
You MUST NOT center align the app container, ie do not add `.App { text-align: center; }` in the css file. This disrupts the human natural reading flow of text.
Always use modern button styles like pill-shaped, or sharp button with interaction animations & color relevant to the app style.
NEVER: use AI assistant Emoji characters like 🤖🧠💭💡🔮🎯 etc for icons.
Every interaction needs micro-animations - hover states, transitions, parallax effects, and entrance animations. Static = dead.
Use 2-3x more spacing than feels comfortable. Cramped designs look cheap.
Subtle grain textures, noise overlays, custom cursors, selection states, and loading animations: separates good from extraordinary.
Main agent relies on these image URLs. Missing categories (especially sponsor logos) = main agent will use placeholder text which is FORBIDDEN.
Prioritize using pre-existing components from src/components/ui when applicable.
Create new components that match the style and conventions of existing components when needed.
Examine existing components to understand the project's component patterns before creating new ones.
Use `sonner` for toasts. Sonner component are located in `/app/frontend/src/components/ui/sonner.js`
